# core-provider — LLM doc index (pinned: 2.12.4)
# One line per file; regenerate the pin on release. Read files at the tag that matches
# the running build (chart version == image tags == the repo tag; no v prefix). The chart's
# cdc/chart-inspector images track appVersion, so one tag pins the whole component.
docs/index.md: the map — what core-provider is + links to the whole bundle and the deep corpus
docs/overview.md: what it does and how it works — the three monorepo components, reconcile flow, digest contract, local vs remote
docs/usage.md: install via the Krateo installer pin or direct helm install oci://…; the k8s >= 1.36 floor; CRDs applied from go/core-provider/crds/
docs/configuration.md: the whole config surface — engine/chart-inspector/cdc values, apiRefRBAC, otel, env ConfigMap, CDC asset templates
docs/api.md: the CompositionDefinition + KubernetesTarget CRDs, generated composition CRDs, chart-inspector HTTP API, metrics endpoint
docs/examples.md: index of the runnable examples
docs/release.md: how a release ships — one plain-semver tag drives three images + the OCI chart
docs/log.md: curated history
examples/basic-composition/README.md: the smallest CompositionDefinition — a chart becomes a Kubernetes API (self-hosting pattern)
examples/basic-composition/manifest.yaml: the manifest — kubectl apply -f
examples/remote-target/README.md: KubernetesTarget + remote-targeted CompositionDefinition projected onto a spoke
examples/remote-target/manifest.yaml: the manifest — kubectl apply -f
# Internals (code-traced; authoritative for the engine's runtime):
docs/internals/architecture.md: how the engine binary is built — entry point, the three controllers, the internal/tools packages
docs/internals/behavior.md: the reconcile lifecycle, what is deployed per version, digest contract, status projection, remote seeding
docs/internals/gotchas.md: real runtime pitfalls, each grounded in code
# How-tos:
docs/how-to/remote-target-credentials.md: KubernetesTarget kubeconfig Secrets with ESO — contract, RBAC, rotation recipes
docs/how-to/remote-target-rbac.yaml: the target-side ClusterRole for remote projection
docs/how-to/apiref-status-projection-authn.md: the apiRef status source — allowlist mapping, issued group, auto-generated RBAC
docs/how-to/migrate-off-remoteinstall.md: migrating the removed RemoteInstall kind to first-class remote Compositions
# Design records (frontmatter status reconciled against the code, 2026-08-07):
docs/design/multicluster-compositions.md: local + remote deployment via KubernetesTarget (diverged: target is namespaced now)
docs/design/remote-composition-mirror.md: hub Composition mirrored onto the spoke; retired RemoteInstall (implemented)
docs/design/remote-projection-self-seeding.md: Path A — self-sufficient projected cdc on the spoke (implemented)
docs/design/remote-installer-proposal.md: deploy a full Krateo onto a spoke (superseded by the mirror model)
docs/design/composition-status-projection.md: declarative statusDataTemplate + apiRef status sources (implemented)
docs/design/composition-status-implementation-roadmap.md: the sequencing plan for status projection (superseded; shipped)
docs/design/apiref-rbac-generation.md: auto-generate apiRef RBAC from snowplow GET /rbac (implemented)
docs/design/composition-version-management.md: multi-version CRDs, instance migration, upgradePolicy (implemented)
docs/design/cdc-sharding.md: CDC horizontal sharding — the recorded decision is NOT to build it yet
docs/design/examples/composition-status-projection/README.md: staged manifests accompanying the status-projection design
# Component-local docs (code-adjacent):
go/composition-dynamic-controller/README.md: the CDC — lifecycle orchestration, status projection runtime, apiRef resolution chain
go/chart-inspector/README.md: chart-inspector — the /resources dry-run render API (swagger at go/chart-inspector/docs/swagger.yaml)
go/core-provider/telemetry/metrics-reference.md: the OTLP metric catalog (opt-in via OTEL_ENABLED)
go/core-provider/apis/compositiondefinitions/v1alpha1/types.go: source of truth for the two owned CRDs
# Archive (frontmatter tags: [archive]; point-in-time record — NOT current truth; never ground answers here without re-verifying against the code):
docs/audit/core-provider-consolidation-plan.md: the 2026 consolidation audit (fork vs upstream roadmap), preserved as a dated record
